values.note: Online reservations ran 5/18-9/13 in 2026; from 9/14 through the park's close all sites are first-come. Sites 20, 30, 35 and 40 aren't reservable. Up to 14 nights per reservation. Call center 800-332-1501.
Map classes: S up to 20 ft, M up to 25, L up to 30, X up to 35, U over 35. S sites 10, 17, 31, 32, 37 and 39 won't fit a 23-ft rig. Site 28 is administrative.

note: Maine state park campground on Lake St. George near Liberty; Route 3 runs close on the far side of the loops. The official guide caps practical RVs at ~24 ft due to a switchback entrance driveway -- the 23-ft EKKO is fine, larger rigs are limited by the entrance, not the sites. Season mid-May to mid-Oct. --Claude
summary: Confirmed 38 numbered sites, some FCFS, showers, dump, no hookups. Added max stay 14, site classes. Note cleaned. Fees and season stand.
flags: WATERFRONT 'lakefront' rests on very few sites: the park page says 'Some of the park's campsites are located right on the shoreline'. The map's lake-side spur holds 27U, 28U (administrative), 30U (not reservable) and 31S (class S, up to 20 ft, won't fit). Only 30U is both a fit and clearly between spur road and lake; the main loop road runs ~25-60 m from the shore over open grass on leaf-off imagery, and its sites behind it are *view by the loop-road rule. Not changed; if one first-come site doesn't carry the call, it goes down to lakeview.

PIN: stored 44.3987,-69.3463 is ~280 m NE of the campground. Corrected ~44.3966,-69.3482 (loop roads seen on leaf-off imagery; OSM service-way centroid 44.39675,-69.348). The agency's own point 44.398005,-69.347611 is the park entrance.
WEBSITE: the map prints www.maine.gov/lakesaintgeorge as the park's address; stored is the longer dacf path.

NOTE's 24-ft/switchback line comes from the park guide (maine.gov PDF, 403, unread today); kept because no field can say it, but not re-confirmed. The 'Open all year' on the park page is the day-use gate, not the campground season.
